publisherAndPublicEvidence.comparativeScholarship: NAER Journal of Textbook Research vol.8 no.1 comparative study reviews older Nani, Kang Hsuan, Hanlin textbook narratives; used only to prompt scrutiny of selection/framing, not as evidence of current edition differences.

synthesis: Replaced four generic learner-facing sections and six generic teaching placeholders with six original sections built around a verifiable historical event and a source-provenance problem. The lesson separates event claims from causal/meaning interpretations, treats the official commemorative postcard as evidence of its issuer's framing rather than collective public opinion, compares transport integration with colonial administration/resource-control interpretations, narrows conclusions to evidence scope, and transfers the method to CAP-style image/source questions. Corrected previously misattributed publisherResearch records; added three scoped versionResearch records, original fusionRecord, direct curriculum and primary-history references. No publisher full-text coverage is claimed.
